newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CSOB lowers prime rate 15 bps to 16.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech CSOB lowers prime rate 15 bps to 16.10 pct.

text.p: Prague-based Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. (CSOB) lowered on Thursday its prime lending rate 15 basis points to 16.10 percent, the bank said in a statement.

It said the base rate for credit with maturities of between one to two years was lowered 50 basis points to 15.50 percent, and the basis rate for two-to-three year credit was lowered 75 basis points to 15.25 percent.
No immediate reason was given for the changes, but rates have been gradually easing throughout the Czech money market in recent weeks.
